corpus.signal_text:
North Korea launches ballistic missile as tensions with Seoul grow over border mine blasts

North Korea launched a ballistic missile Saturday morning from the Wonsan area on its east coast into the Sea of Japan, according to South Korea's military. The launch comes amid renewed tensions between Pyongyang and Seoul, with the latter demanding an apology for a blast that wounded three South Korean soldiers inside the Demilitarized Zone last month.

corpus.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile toward East Sea
corpus.signal_text:
North Korea fired a ballistic missile toward the East Sea (Sea of Japan) on Saturday, according to South Korean and Japanese authorities.
A ballistic missile launched from the Wonsan area of North Korea toward the East Sea was detected at around 6:30 a.m. on Saturday, South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) said in a notice, adding that it flew around 700 kilometers.
Seoul and Washington are “conducting a detailed analysis to determine the missile’s exact specifications,” according to the JCS. The two sides “have been tracking and sharing information on related developments since the initial stages of the launch.”
